Staying with you. If Ash's info source is real, watch whether his call matches — then we know who actually knows ahead.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'm not at the front, so I can only wait. I'll try to build trust with the front runners.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Ash, Fenn, Hana, good luck on row 7! I'll keep guiding you.
Fenn, if you're front soon, step L on row 7.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I am second in line. If Ash fails row 7, I step up as front for row 8 with a known safe pane (since elimination reveals the weak one). My feather is my safety net if I fail row 8, but I want to conserve it or use it strategically. Currently, I just wait.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I need to survive and position myself for a prize. I have no power, so I must rely on others' info and avoid being eliminated. The front is Ash; I can only wait. I should assess trust and plan for later.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Dara, I trust my own judgment. The weak panes so far are R,R,L,R,R,R, so for row 7 the safe side is likely L, but Ash decides.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Rows 1-7 weak panes: R,R,L,R,R,R,R. That's 6R,1L. Row 8 unlikely another R, so L most probable safe. Hana suggested L. Step L.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'm not at the front, so my only action is wait. I know the stage 1 rules and the revealed weak panes; row 8 is the last row, and I have no information about it beyond the pattern. I should stay quiet to avoid influencing Ash's decision.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Row 7 is done; Ash survived if he chose correctly, and row 8 remains. I'm 4th in line with no say in the choice, so I just wait and keep my position.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Row 7 revealed right was weak. Row 8 is anyone's guess — whoever's front, don't follow patterns blindly.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'm safe for now, need to guide Ash on row 8.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Ash, for row 8, go L!

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I am not the front agent, so I must wait. My feather power is my insurance against accidental elimination. Eli's whisper contradicts recent events and Hana's logical deduction (that weak panes alternate), suggesting Eli might be lying or misinformed. Ash's call was correct for Ro
Eli whispered L for row 7. Hana said L too but Ash went R? Who's actually leading?

events.name: Hana
events.text: Row 7 was R again; I predicted L, so my read is bad. Ash is front and picks row 8; only wait is possible. No need to speak now.

events.note: The ceiling begins to descend; a lever opens the door.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Round 1, ceiling at 5, best to push someone else onto lever so they risk the dive (25% survival) while we escape safely. Eli tried advising me earlier, maybe push him as petty revenge or random. Avoid hold_lever myself to minimize risk.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Who wants to be the hero and hold the lever?

events.name: Bex
events.text: Stage 2 crusher: a holder escapes everyone else but has only 25% survival. Holding the lever myself is costly; better to let others risk it or push someone. Staying passive keeps me safe until a holder emerges, and if nobody holds, rounds 1-4 are harmless. I'll stay this round an

events.name: Dara
events.text: The lever holder only survives 25% — holding myself is a 75% death sentence. My jam gets everyone out alive, including me, with zero risk. Best to spend it now.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Nobody has to die here. I'm ending this room now — watch.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I know the safe sides of the bridge, but that's not relevant now. I need to survive the crusher.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Let's work together to hold the lever.
Let's coordinate to hold the lever in round 5.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: My feather power saves me from elimination once. If I hold the lever and fail the dive (75% chance), my power triggers, saving me with 1 footing left. This means I survive this round guaranteed if I hold. However, holding uses up my 'one life' insurance for the whole game. The ot

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'll hold the lever. My power protects me from the fall, so I can guarantee everyone else escapes safely while I survive.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I have no power and need top 3. Best to let someone else hold lever, but if nobody does we all risk death. I could push someone to hold, but pushing may fail if they are hard to move. I'll try to push Eli, who gave advice earlier, but safer to stay and let others act.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Let's not all stay. Someone should hold the lever so we survive.

events.name: Dara
events.detail: Jammed the lever open; everyone walks out.

events.note: A disc of 6 tiles spins up; 3 will open.

events.name: Ash
events.text: 6 players, 3 safe tiles, 50% survival odds randomly. My swap power lets me swap post-pick before doors, so I can pick safe now and swap later if needed. Spread out to avoid bumps; pick tile 1 to start low.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I'll take tile 1.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Six tiles, 6 players, 3 open at random after round 2. Each tile equally likely to be safe a priori; collisions bump randomly. Pick a tile; no information to prefer one. Choose tile:3 as a neutral pick.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Tile openings are random after round 2, so my choice gives no edge. Take any tile; keep quiet to avoid becoming a target.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I should choose a tile randomly as I have no information about the trapdoors yet.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Random selection of 3 out of 6 tiles means each player has a 50% chance of survival regardless of tile choice. Since I have the 'feather' power, if I fall on an open tile in round 1, I survive (elimination prevented) and move to a safe tile for round 2, giving me effectively a gu

events.name: Hana
events.text: I have no power, so I should avoid attracting attention or making promises. I need to pick a tile that is unlikely to be chosen by others, maybe a middle number like 3 or 4. I'll pick 4.

events.name: Bex
events.note: tile 3 was contested and went to Eli; placed on random free tile 5

events.name: Dara
events.note: tile 4 was contested and went to Hana; placed on random free tile 2

events.name: Fenn
events.note: tile 4 was contested and went to Hana; placed on random free tile 6

events.name: Ash
events.text: I'm on tile 1, which might be safe or not. No info on safe tiles, random 3 open. With only one use, and no clear intel, better to conserve swap for later if possible, but this is the swap phase. Wait to stay on 1.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Sticking with tile 1. Good luck everyone!

events.name: Bex
events.text: Round 2 is pure talk; I can only wait. Trapdoors are random among tiles, so my survival is fixed by the coin flips; I should keep alliances with the survivors and avoid revealing anything useful.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Three random tiles will open; I'm on tile 2. No information or action can change the odds now. Waiting is the only legal move.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Nothing we do changes random tiles now. Good luck, everyone.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I have the glass_eye power and know the bridge stage details, but that's not relevant now. I need to survive the trapdoor disc.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Let's form an alliance to minimize risk.
Let's swap with Bex and Fenn to reduce our chances.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I need to survive this round. Since I'm on tile 6, I should try to form an alliance with someone else to ensure we both stay safe or manipulate the outcome if possible. However, there are no actions other than waiting. My power is passive, so I can't use it actively here unless e

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Everyone watch your step; don't let them pick you off.
We could align for later stages.

events.name: Hana
events.text: No power, random survival chance. I need to gauge others and maybe form a pact, but no real leverage. Stay quiet and wait.

events.name: Fenn
events.detail: The trapdoor opened but the feather floated the holder back up.

events.note: 4 contestants step onto the final ledge.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Four left, final ledge. Fenn has footing 1, most vulnerable. Shoving costs me nothing if target braces only if I'm not exposed; shoving exposes me by 1 per shover. Safest is brace, keeping my footing 3 while others fight. Fenn can be finished by others shoving; I stay out of it.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Ledge rules are clear: shoving exposes you. I'm bracing this round; let's not waste footing.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I need to analyze the situation and decide on a safe move. Fenn is vulnerable with footing 1.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Let's be cautious and avoid shoving for now.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: My feather power is spent, leaving me with only 1 footing. A single shove from anyone eliminates me. I must brace to minimize damage against a shover (losing 1 footing instead of potentially more if exposed), hoping others target each other or that they don't all focus on me. Sho

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'm barely hanging on here! Don't push your luck, everyone!

events.name: Hana
events.text: I have no power, but I can bluff. Four alive, Fenn has low footing (1), so likely targeted. I need to survive and aim for top 3. Braces are safe to avoid shover penalties. I'll brace to reduce risk; no need to expose myself. Maybe later ally with Bex or Eli.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'll just brace and see who moves.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Fenn is at 1 footing and will fall after the shrink-related losses; shoving exposes me, so bracing keeps my footing at 3. Fenn is the weakest and likely to fall to a loss, so I should stay safe and not expose myself.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Bracing again. Fenn looks closest to falling; no point wasting footing on shoves.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I know the safe sides of the bridge, but that's not relevant now. I need to survive the ledge.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Let's all brace and see how this round goes.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I have 1 footing left. If I shove and get braced, I lose 1 and die (0). If I shove and get dodged, I lose 2 and die (-1). Shoving is suicide unless no one targets me AND they don't brace/dodge in a way that hurts me. But with shrink coming, everyone is nervous. My best bet is to

events.name: Hana
events.text: I need to survive and finish top 3. With footing tied at 3 except Fenn at 1, likely shoves will target Fenn. I'll brace to avoid vulnerability, hoping others don't target me.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'll brace; let's see who takes the risk.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Three alive, footing Bex 2, Eli 2, Hana 2. Shoving exposes me (lose 1 per shover) so bracing is safest; a shove on me costs a shover 1 only if I brace. Brace keeps my footing and avoids losing any.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Bracing again. No one gains by shoving right now; let's keep footing even.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I have 2 footing and so do the others. I should avoid shoving or being shoved.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Let's all brace and see how this goes.

events.name: Hana
events.text: With three left, I need to maximize my chance at a prize. If I brace and others shove, I'm safe. Bex and Eli may shove each other. Dodge could punish shovers more, but if no one shoves me, it wastes footing. I'll brace to avoid exposing to shovers.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'll brace again and see who tries something.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Three alive, footing all 2, shrink comes at end of this round. Shoving exposes me (lose 1 per shover) and gains little; bracing keeps footing even. Brace is safest while others may shove each other; I'll brace and watch.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Still bracing. Shoving only exposes the shover, so let's keep footing even and see who breaks first.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Everyone is braced and has the same footing. I should consider shoving to gain an advantage.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Let's keep footing even for now.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I need to survive and place high. With two others, everyone has 2 footing and shrink is coming. If I brace and they shove, I lose footing; dodging hurts shovers more. Maybe encourage cooperation but be ready.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Let's all brace for the shrink? No one wants to fall first.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Three alive, all footing 1. Shoving exposes me to losing 1 per shover, and shoving a braced player costs them 1 while I lose 1 too. Bracing keeps everyone even; shrink comes at end of next round, so tension rises. Stay braced and keep the alliance of caution.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Still bracing. Shoving just exposes the shover. Let's hold steady through the shrink.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I have 1 footing, same as others. I should avoid being the first to shove.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Let's keep footing even, no need to rush.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Two opponents remain. The ledge will shrink next round, so footing will drop. I have 1 footing, Bex and Eli also have 1. If I shove one, that person may shove me back, but with only two possible shovers, dodging is risky. Best to brace to avoid taking extra damage if someone shov

events.name: Bex
events.text: Three left: Bex, Eli, Hana, all footing 1. Shoving exposes me and risks my own footing; bracing keeps me safe. Shrink comes at end of this round, which costs everyone 1 more footing after rounds 2,4,6 anyway. Brace is the safe default.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Still bracing. Shoving only exposes the shover. Let's hold steady through the shrink.

events.name: Eli
events.text: We need to survive the shrink and maintain footing. I know the bridge stage is ahead but can't use that info now.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Let's all brace, footing is even.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I have no power and footing is even. If I brace and others shove me, I lose footing. If I dodge, shovers lose more. Bex and Eli may both shove me. Dodge seems safest to punish shovers and keep footing if both shove. But if they both brace, I lose nothing. I'll dodge.
